item.title: Are TropiBlend Products All Natural? What's Really in Each Jar
item.description: Yes. Every TropiBlend product is made from fresh and natural ingredients with no artificial preservatives. The salsas are mostly fruit and vegetables with lime, cane sugar, salt, pepper, herbs and spices; the pesto is basil, parmesan, extra virgin olive oil and cashew nuts. The full ingredient list is printed on every label.

item.title: What Is TropiBlend? Gourmet Condiments Made in Cagayan de Oro
item.description: TropiBlend is a Filipino food brand from Cagayan de Oro City that makes six small-batch gourmet condiments: Pineapple Salsa, Mango Salsa, Pickled Cucumber, Pickled Onion, Pesto and Mango Salad Dressing. Everything is made from fresh and natural ingredients with no artificial preservatives, and you can order directly through Facebook Messenger, by phone or by email.

item.title: What to Eat With Mango Salsa: 10 Easy Ideas
item.description: Mango salsa is best with grilled fish, shrimp and other seafood, grilled or fried chicken, tacos, and green salads. It also works as a dip with tortilla chips or crackers and as a fresh topping for rice bowls. Its sweet-tangy flavor cuts through smoky, salty and rich food, which is why it goes so well with Filipino grilled dishes.

item.title: What to Eat With Pineapple Salsa: Fish, Tacos, Pork and More
item.description: Pineapple salsa goes best with grilled fish, shrimp tacos, grilled and fried pork like liempo or lechon kawali, and as a dip with tortilla chips or crackers. Its sweet-and-tangy pineapple flavor balances salty, smoky and fatty food, making it a natural partner for Filipino grilled dishes.

item.title: 12 Ways to Use Pickled Onions (Beyond Burgers)
item.description: Pickled onions add crunch, tang and color to almost any savory dish. Use them on burgers and sandwiches, with inihaw and lechon manok, on fried chicken, in tacos, beside tapsilog and other silog meals, on salads and avocado toast, and on pizza or nachos. TropiBlend Pickled Onion comes ready to eat in a 350 ml jar.

item.title: How to Use Pesto: 12 Ideas Beyond Pasta
item.description: Besides pasta, use pesto as a spread on toast, pandesal and sandwiches, a marinade or topping for grilled chicken, pork and fish, a pizza sauce, a stir-in for scrambled eggs and soups, a dip mixed with mayo or cream cheese, and a dressing for potato salad or roasted vegetables. TropiBlend Pesto is made with basil, parmesan, extra virgin olive oil and cashew nuts.

item.title: Best Condiments for Inihaw: Beyond Toyomansi and Suka
item.description: The best condiments for inihaw balance smoky, salty grilled meat with something tangy and fresh. Alongside the classic toyomansi and spiced vinegar, try pickled onion and pickled cucumber with liempo and pork BBQ, pineapple salsa with pork, and mango salsa with grilled fish and chicken. Serve two or three so everyone can mix and match.

item.title: Food Gift and Pasalubong Ideas From Cagayan de Oro

They're made in CDO from fresh, natural ingredients, look good in their labeled jars, and are something the recipient will actually use. Order by Messenger or at 0956 447 9961.

item.title: Pickled Cucumber vs Atchara: What's the Difference?
item.description: Atchara is the classic Filipino pickle made mainly from grated green papaya and is usually sweet. TropiBlend Pickled Cucumber is made from crunchy Japanese cucumber with dill and lime, so it's crisper, fresher and more herby. Both do the same job on the plate, cutting through rich, grilled and fried food, so you can use pickled cucumber anywhere you'd serve atchara.
